verses.text: After this I heard what sounded like the loud voice of a huge crowd in heaven, shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God,
for his judgments are true and fair. He has judged the great prostitute who ruined the earth with her sexual sin. He has punished her for the blood of his servants."
And again they shouted: "Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up forever and ever."
The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God, who sits on the throne. They said: "Amen! Hallelujah!"
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all you his servants, all who fear him, both small and great!"
Then I heard what sounded like a huge crowd, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud thunder, shouting: "Hallelujah! For the Lord our God Almighty rules!
Let us be glad and full of joy, and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.
She has been given fine linen, bright and clean, to wear." The fine linen stands for the right things that God's holy people have done.
Then the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!" And he added, "These are the true words of God."

Then I fell down at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Do not do that! I am a servant like you and like your brothers and sisters who hold on to what Jesus told. Worship God! For telling about Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True. He judges fairly and makes war for what is right.
His eyes are like flames of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows except himself.
He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is The Word of God.
The armies of heaven followed him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.
Out of his mouth comes a sharp sword to strike down the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He crushes the grapes in the winepress of the fierce anger of God Almighty.
On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
Then I saw an angel standing in the sun. He shouted in a loud voice to all the birds flying in the sky, "Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
so that you can eat the flesh of kings, army leaders, and mighty men, the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, small and great."
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered together to make war against the rider on the horse and his army.

But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had done miracles for it. By those miracles he had fooled those who received the mark of the beast and worshipped its statue. The two of them were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulphur.
The rest were killed with the sword that came out of the mouth of the rider on the horse. And all the birds ate their fill of their flesh.
